component.name: spiffe
component.title: SPIFFE
component.description: Fetch and validate SPIFFE workload identity (X.509-SVID and JWT-SVID) from the SPIFFE Workload API.
component.label: security

audience.description: The comma-separated audience(s) to request for a JWT-SVID (fetchJwtSvid) or to validate against (validateJwtSvid). Can be overridden per-message with the CamelSpiffeAudience header. Note that validateJwtSvid validates against a single audience, so when several comma-separated audiences are given only the first one is used for validation; fetchJwtSvid requests all of them.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

operation.description: The operation to perform on the SPIFFE Workload API.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

workloadApiClient.label: advanced
workloadApiClient.description: An existing WorkloadApiClient to use. When set, the component does not create or close its own client and spiffeSocketPath is ignored.

spiffeSocketPath.label: security
spiffeSocketPath.description: The address of the SPIFFE Workload API endpoint (for example {code unix:///tmp/agent.sock} or {code tcp://127.0.0.1:8082}). When not set, the SPIFFE_ENDPOINT_SOCKET environment variable is used.

CamelSpiffeOperation.label: producer
CamelSpiffeOperation.description: Overrides the operation to be used by the producer.

CamelSpiffeAudience.label: producer
CamelSpiffeAudience.description: The comma-separated audience(s) for the fetchJwtSvid and validateJwtSvid operations.

CamelSpiffeToken.label: producer
CamelSpiffeToken.description: The JWT-SVID token to validate, for the validateJwtSvid operation.

CamelSpiffeSpiffeId.label: producer
CamelSpiffeSpiffeId.description: The SPIFFE ID of the returned SVID.

CamelSpiffeExpiry.label: producer
CamelSpiffeExpiry.description: The expiry of the returned JWT-SVID.
